TMC internal power struggle escalates over party leadership

The Trinamool Congress (TMC) is experiencing an internal power struggle concerning its leadership. The faction loyal to Mamata Banerjee has submitted a list of office-bearers to the Election Commission, asserting her position as chairperson. Meanwhile, a rebel faction has reportedly named Arup Roy as the new chairperson, claiming control of the "real party."
